# Nur

> Nur is a calm, focused prayer companion app for iOS and Android, currently in development. It brings prayer times, a Quran reader, guided Athkar (remembrance), a Tasbeeh counter, and a live Qibla compass together in one quiet, glass-styled interface. This site is Nur's marketing page — it also hosts a full interactive web recreation of the app so visitors can try it before it launches.

Design direction: warm emerald and gold, glassmorphism, dark-only. Built by a solo developer (@eyadmaherrr).

## Pages
- [Home](https://downloadnur.com/): Overview of Nur's features (prayer times, Quran, Athkar, Qibla) plus a live interactive demo of the app running in the browser.
- [Download](https://downloadnur.com/download): Coming-soon page for iOS and Android with a waitlist signup, emailed the moment Nur launches on Google Play.
- [FAQ](https://downloadnur.com/faq): Answers about what Nur is, offline support, Quran audio, prayer calculation methods, Athkar, Qibla, notifications, and platform availability.

## Optional
- [llms-full.txt](https://downloadnur.com/llms-full.txt): Full page content for all pages on this site, expanded for deeper context.
